events.source: before february 24th you didn't have to go far on the internet to find people claiming that russia possessed the world's second most powerful military
events.text: 在2月24日之前，你在网上不用费多大功夫，就能找到有人声称俄罗斯拥有世界第二强大的军队。

events.source: the internet was practically drowning in articles and indexes all of which confidently put russia in second
events.text: 互联网上几乎充斥着文章和索引，它们都信誓旦旦地把俄罗斯排在第二位。

events.source: heck there are even a few that put russia in first
events.text: 见鬼，甚至还有少数把俄罗斯排在第一位。

events.source: presumably written by people who thought the ultimate arbiter of military strength remained the size of a country's tank fleet
events.text: 大概是那些认为军事实力最终仍由一国坦克部队规模裁定的人写的。

events.source: after all who cares how many nuclear aircraft carriers or stealth bombers the americans have
events.text: 毕竟，谁在乎美国人有多少核动力航母或隐形轰炸机？

events.source: if ivan's got 10 000 t-62s rusting in siberia somewhere
events.text: 如果伊万在西伯利亚某处有一万辆锈蚀的T-62坦克

events.source: and while it's easy to laugh at these kind of narratives the fact remains that
events.text: 而且，尽管人们很容易嘲笑这类说法，但事实仍然是：

events.source: these sort of articles got millions of views and eyeballs they shaped public opinion
events.text: 这类文章获得了数百万次浏览、吸引了数百万关注，也塑造了公众舆论。

events.source: and all i could really think looking at these even long before the invasion was what about china
events.text: 而我看着这些文章时，真正想到的只有：甚至早在入侵之前，中国又如何呢？

events.source: because while i feel like russia does a very good job of exaggerating its international reputation and military capabilities china's modernization efforts are often undersold
events.text: 因为我觉得，俄罗斯很善于夸大自己的国际声誉和军事实力，而中国的现代化努力却往往被低估。

events.source: now of course there are lots of varied voices out there
events.text: 当然，现在外界也有很多不同的声音。

events.source: but there are certainly a lot out there that underestimate the scale of chinese modernization and stress the tremendous spending advantage that countries like the united states continue to enjoy
events.text: 但确实有很多人低估中国现代化的规模，并强调美国等国家仍享有巨大的军费开支优势

events.source: which leads you to ask the question if chinese defence spending is so minimal well then where are all these stealth fighters aircraft carriers hypersonic missiles and anti-ship ballistic missiles coming from
events.text: 这就让人不禁要问：如果中国国防开支如此之少，那么这些隐形战斗机、航空母舰、高超音速导弹和反舰弹道导弹都从何而来？

events.source: and yet you will find people who are more impressed with russia driving four t 14 armada tanks across red square every victory day parade then they are with china building an aircraft carrier fleet out of nothing
events.text: 然而，你会发现，有些人对俄罗斯每年胜利日阅兵时驾驶四辆T-14“阿玛塔”坦克驶过红场的印象，比对中国从无到有建造航母舰队的印象更深。

events.source: fielding a fifth generation fighter ahead of every country other than the united states
events.text: 中国部署第五代战斗机，领先除美国外的所有国家。

events.source: and greatly modernizing just about every aspect of its military capabilities over the course of the last two decades
events.text: 并在过去二十年间大幅推进其几乎所有军事能力方面的现代化。

events.source: the reality of course is that the transformation of the pla's capabilities over the last two decades has been astonishing
events.text: 当然，现实是，解放军过去二十年能力的转型令人震惊。

events.source: in 1996 china could reach the korean peninsula with perhaps a couple of dozen conventional ballistic missiles
events.text: 1996年，中国或许能用二十几枚常规弹道导弹打到朝鲜半岛。

events.source: by 2017 it had thousands of such systems capable of reaching out past japan
events.text: 到2017年，中国已有数千套此类系统，能够打到日本以外的地方。

events.source: 20 years ago chinese sams basically only covered a couple of critical cities and bases on the mainland
events.text: 二十年前，中国的地对空导弹基本上只覆盖大陆上少数几个重要城市和基地。

events.source: come 2017 surface-to-air missiles based on mainland china could range
events.text: 到了2017年，部署在中国大陆的地对空导弹射程可以……

events.source: out over taiwan itself so what am i going to be talking about today
events.text: ……射程可达台湾本岛上空。所以，我今天要讲些什么呢？

events.source: well i've talked before about the fact that military strategy is built strategy
events.text: 嗯，我以前谈过，军事战略是构建出来的战略。

events.source: so rather than jumping in and talking straight about the modern technologies or platforms that china has at its disposal i thought i'd talk about the first half of the modernization picture
events.text: 所以，与其直接谈中国可用的现代技术或平台，我想先谈现代化图景的前半部分：

events.source: the chinese military budget its industry and its procurement strategies
events.text: 中国的军费预算、军工产业和采购战略。

events.source: i'm going to cover a little bit of history on china's modernization efforts
events.text: 我还会简要介绍一些中国现代化努力的历史。

events.source: and then i'm going to drill into the chinese military budget and defence spending
events.text: 接下来，我将深入探讨中国军费预算和国防开支。

events.source: essentially i'm going to try and explain why it seems like china can catch up with the united states while spending a fraction as much on its defense budget
events.text: 我将尝试解释，为什么中国似乎只花美国国防预算的一小部分，就能追赶上美国。

events.source: and basically the argument comes down to four parts
events.text: 论点基本可归纳为四个方面。

events.source: firstly that the chinese defense budget is actually larger than you think it is not because they're trying to hide it but because of different accounting standards inclusions and exclusions
events.text: 第一，中国的国防预算实际上比你以为的更大；这不是因为他们想隐瞒，而是因为会计标准不同，以及纳入和排除的项目不同。

events.source: secondly because china gets better value for its money because of purchasing power parity advantages
events.text: 第二，中国的钱花得更值，因为购买力平价带来优势。

events.source: thirdly because of some peculiarities in the massive industrial base that supports chinese military modernization
events.text: 第三，原因在于支撑中国军事现代化的庞大工业基础有一些特殊之处。

events.source: and finally because china simply spends a greater percentage of its budget on new equipment and modernization as opposed to salaries training or maintaining existing systems in the way that nations like the us does
events.text: 最后还因为，中国把预算中更大比例用于新装备和现代化，而不像美国这样的国家那样用于薪酬、训练或维护现有系统。

events.source: i'm going to ask the question is
events.text: 我要问的问题是

events.source: the budget holistic is there anything that's left out
events.text: 预算是否全面？有没有遗漏？

events.source: that should be included
events.text: 有没有应该纳入的内容？

events.source: how do you adjust for purchasing power parity namely the fact that things are cheaper in china than they are in other jurisdictions
events.text: 如何按购买力平价调整，也就是考虑到中国物价比其他司法管辖区更低这一事实？

events.source: i want to look at chinese defense industry briefly chart the evidence of progress in terms of modernization previewing the next episode
events.text: 我想简要考察中国国防工业，梳理现代化方面的进展证据，并预告下一期。
